tasks.title: Render executor marks as solid enamel contours
tasks.objective: Replace the fluorescent avatar outline with a closed neutral backing, 1px clearance, and an opaque 1px tint rim around the combined Provider and badge mark.
tasks.outcome: Hollow Provider marks remain legible, source colors stay intact, and no avatar or connecting surface emits a blur or status glow.
acceptance: The shared filter closes alpha holes, grows a neutral backing by 2px, and creates the tint rim from the 3px minus 2px alpha difference.
The original SourceGraphic is composited above the enamel surface; both production AgentAvatar and connecting surfaces use the shared filter.
Avatar contour and connecting CSS contain no drop-shadow or glow rules, and status remains in the shared status pip.
